title: Mystical Green Mountain Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 青峦幽谷壁纸 — 五行风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This enchanting wallpaper depicts a serene mountain landscape bathed in soft green hues, symbolizing the Wood element (木) and its nurturing energy. The flowing river and lush trees evoke the Water element (水), creating a harmonious balance that supports growth and renewal. This imagery aligns with the BaZi favorable combination of 喜水木 (Water + Wood), resonating with the Heart/Small Intestine meridian and the Xun (Wood/East) trigram. It is ideal for those seeking clarity, creativity, and emotional well-being, particularly benefiting careers in writing, design, or healing arts. Use this background to cultivate a peaceful mindset, enhance intuition, and attract opportunities for personal and professional growth.
description_zh: 此壁纸展现幽静青峦山水，绿意盎然，象征木元素（木）与滋养能量。溪流树木交融水元素（水），形成和谐共生之态，契合八字喜用神喜水木组合，对应心小肠经络及巽卦（木/东方）。适合追求清晰、创意与情感平衡者，尤其助力写作、设计或疗愈类职业发展。使用此壁纸可助培养平和心境，提升直觉力，吸引个人与事业成长机遇。

title: Cosmic Tree Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 宇宙树壁纸 — 五行风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This mesmerizing wallpaper features a celestial tree with swirling cosmic energy, symbolizing the connection between Earth and the universe. The dominant colors of teal and gold evoke the Water and Metal elements, creating a harmonious balance that resonates with the Kan (Water) and Dui (Metal) trigrams. This image is ideal for those seeking to enhance their intuition, wisdom, and analytical thinking, aligning with the Five Elements' Water-Metal cycle.
description_zh: 此壁纸描绘了一棵宇宙之树，其流动的星云与金色能量象征着天地之间的连接。主色调青蓝与金黄对应水与金元素，契合坎（水）与兑（金）卦象。适合希望提升直觉、智慧与分析能力的人群，助力金水相生的能量流动。

title: Blue Dragon Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 蓝龙壁纸 — 五行风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This striking wallpaper features a majestic blue dragon amidst swirling golden clouds, embodying the powerful energy of Water and Wood. The dragon, a symbol of strength, wisdom, and transformation, resonates with the Kan (坎) trigram and the Water element, activating the Kidney/Bladder meridian. It also incorporates Wood through its flowing, dynamic form, supporting the Liver/Gallbladder meridian. This image is ideal for those whose BaZi favors Water and Wood (喜水木), enhancing creativity, growth, and intuitive insight. Perfect for individuals in careers like writing, design, or healing, it promotes personal empowerment and spiritual evolution.
description_zh: 此壁纸以威严的蓝色神龙为核心，周围环绕着金色祥云，象征水与木的能量。龙为力量、智慧与变革的化身，对应坎卦（Water）及肾膀胱经络，同时其灵动形态亦体现木元素，滋养肝胆经络。适合八字喜水木之人，助于提升创造力、成长力与直觉洞察力，尤其适合从事写作、设计或疗愈类职业者，可激发个人潜能与灵性成长。

title: Lotus and Goldfish Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 莲花金鱼壁纸 — 时来运转风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This elegant wallpaper features vibrant goldfish swimming gracefully among soft green lotus leaves, symbolizing abundance, prosperity, and positive energy flow. The golden hue of the fish aligns with the Fire element, while the lotus represents purity and spiritual growth, resonating with the Water element. Together, this imagery supports the BaZi favorable combination of 喜水木 (Water + Wood), activating the Kidney/Bladder meridian (Water) and Liver/Gallbladder meridian (Wood). It enhances intuition, wisdom, and personal growth, making it ideal for those seeking career advancement in creative fields like writing, design, or healing arts. Use this serene image as a phone background to invite good fortune and inspire a sense of calm and clarity in daily life.
description_zh: 此壁纸以灵动的金鱼游弋于淡雅莲叶间为主题，象征富贵、吉祥与正能量流动。金鱼的金色属火，莲叶的青翠属水，二者相生，契合八字喜用神中的‘喜水木’组合，滋养肾膀胱经（水）与肝胆经（木）。适合追求智慧与成长的人群，尤其助力创意类职业如写作、设计或疗愈行业的发展。作为手机壁纸使用，可带来好运与内心的宁静。

title: Green Feng Shui Fish Wallpaper — Harmonize Your Energy
title_zh: 五行鱼壁纸 — 和谐能量风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This elegant green Feng Shui wallpaper features golden fish gracefully circling a central BaZi (Four Pillars) chart, symbolizing abundance and prosperity. The dominant green hue aligns with the Wood element, resonating with Jupiter's expansive energy and the Heart/Small Intestine meridian. This design is ideal for those seeking to enhance creativity, growth, and emotional clarity in their lives. The meditative Buddha figure at the bottom promotes inner peace and spiritual alignment, making it perfect for balancing Yin-Yang energies.
description_zh: 此款绿色风水壁纸以金色锦鲤环绕中央四柱图表为核心，象征财源广进与吉祥如意。主色调青绿属木，对应木生火的五行相生关系，契合心经与小肠经脉，助人提升创造力与情感智慧。底部冥想佛陀形象则带来宁静祥和之感，整体设计有助于调和阴阳气场。

title: Ocean Waves Wallpaper — Calming Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 海洋波浪壁纸 — 宁静风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This stunning wallpaper depicts serene ocean waves and playful dolphins, embodying the energy of Water (水). The flowing blue hues resonate with the Kan trigram (坎), symbolizing depth, wisdom, and intuition. This imagery aligns with the Five Elements' Water phase, activating the Kidney/Bladder meridian (water) and promoting emotional balance and inner clarity. Ideal for those with a BaZi profile favoring 喜金水 (Metal + Water) or 喜水木 (Water + Wood), this design supports analytical minds and creative souls. Use it as a calming phone background to enhance focus, attract abundance, and foster a sense of tranquility in daily life.
description_zh: 此壁纸展现宁静的海浪与嬉戏的海豚，蕴含水元素的能量。流动的蓝色调对应坎卦（水），象征深度、智慧与直觉。画面契合五行水气，激活肾膀胱经络，助于情绪平衡与内心清明。适合八字喜金水或喜水木之人，助力理性思维与创意表达。用作手机背景，可舒缓心情，提升专注力，吸引财富，营造日常生活的宁静氛围。

title: Golden Immortal Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 金仙壁纸 — 五行风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This ethereal wallpaper depicts a celestial immortal in flowing golden robes, set against a mystical landscape of towering mountains and divine clouds. The dominant golden hues symbolize the Fire element (火), radiating warmth, illumination, and spiritual energy. White cranes in flight represent purity and longevity, further enhancing the harmonious atmosphere. This image resonates with those whose BaZi chart favors Fire and Earth elements (喜火土), as it supports the Heart/Small Intestine meridian and promotes nurturing qualities. Ideal for individuals in healthcare, real estate, or creative fields seeking to attract abundance and clarity.
description_zh: 此壁纸描绘了一位身着飘逸金袍的仙子，立于云山之间，金色光辉环绕，象征火元素（火）的温暖与灵性。白鹤飞舞增添纯净与长寿之意。适合八字喜火土之人，可滋养心小肠经络，助事业兴旺、心境平和。

title: Moonlit Water Goddess Wallpaper — Enhance Intuition & Calm
title_zh: 月光流水仙女壁纸 — 提升直觉与宁静风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This enchanting wallpaper depicts a celestial water goddess gracefully standing in moonlit waters, surrounded by cascading waterfalls and a luminous full moon. The dominant blue and white hues evoke the energy of Water (Kan), symbolizing wisdom, intuition, and emotional depth. This imagery aligns with the Third Eye Chakra (Ajna) and Mercury's influence, promoting clarity, insight, and inner peace. For those with a BaZi birth chart favoring 喜水木 (Water + Wood), this scene resonates deeply, as it supports the Kidney/Bladder meridian (Water) and Liver/Gallbladder meridian (Wood). It is ideal for individuals seeking to enhance their intuitive abilities, foster calmness, or pursue careers in writing, design, or healing arts.
description_zh: 画面展现一位月光下的水仙女，立于流水之上，周围瀑布飞泻，明月高悬。整体蓝白色调彰显水元素（坎）的能量，象征智慧、直觉与情感深度。此图对应第三眼轮（Ajna）与水星能量，助人提升洞察力与内心平静。对于八字喜用神为喜水木（水+木）者尤为契合，可滋养肾膀胱经络（水）与肝胆经络（木）。适合希望提升直觉、寻求内心安宁或从事写作、设计、疗愈类职业的人群。

title: Phoenix Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background for Fire Energy
title_zh: 凤凰壁纸 — 火元素风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This vibrant wallpaper depicts a majestic phoenix and a graceful woman in traditional red attire, symbolizing fire energy and rebirth. The dominant red hues align with the Jupiter (expansion) and Sun (vitality) planetary energies, while the chakra connection is to the Heart (Anahata) and Solar Plexus (Manipura), enhancing passion and willpower. The image embodies the 喜火土 (Favorable: Fire + Earth) BaZi combination, resonating with the Heart/Small Intestine meridian (Fire) and Spleen/Stomach meridian (Earth). It benefits those seeking leadership, creativity, or emotional healing, particularly in careers like healthcare, real estate, or performing arts. Use this wallpaper to ignite your inner strength and attract abundance.
description_zh: 此壁纸描绘了一只雄伟的凤凰与一位身着传统红衣的优雅女子，象征火元素与重生。主色调红色对应木星（扩展）与太阳（活力）行星能量，同时与心轮（Anahata）和脐轮（Manipura）脉轮相连，提升热情与意志力。图像体现八字喜用神中的“喜火土”组合，对应心包经（火）与脾胃经（土）。适合寻求领导力、创造力或情感疗愈的人群，尤其在医疗、房地产或表演艺术领域。使用此壁纸可激发内在力量，吸引丰盛能量。

title: Five Elements Wallpaper — Harmonious Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 五行壁纸 — 和谐风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This elegant Five Elements wallpaper features a serene blend of natural and mythical elements, embodying the harmony of Wood and Earth. The lush golden fields and majestic mountains represent the Earth element, while the graceful deer and vibrant dragon symbolize the Wood element. This imagery resonates with the BaZi favorable combination of 喜土金 (Earth + Metal), supporting the Spleen/Stomach meridian and promoting groundedness and stability. The trigram Gen () further enhances this energy, symbolizing stillness and nurturing. Ideal for those seeking balance in their career, particularly in finance, law, or engineering, this wallpaper fosters a sense of calm and focus.
description_zh: 此五行壁纸融合自然与神话元素，展现木土和谐之美。金黄田野与巍峨山峦为土象，鹿与青龙为木象，契合八字喜用神喜土金（土+金），滋养脾胃经络，助人稳重踏实。卦象艮（）增其静谧滋养之力。适合从事金融、法律或工程等需稳定之人，助其心平气和、专注事业。

title: Ethereal Green Goddess Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 青灵仙子壁纸 — 五行风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This enchanting wallpaper depicts a serene, ethereal goddess surrounded by lush greenery, blooming peonies, and mystical creatures like deer and birds. The dominant green hues evoke the Wood element (木), symbolizing growth, harmony, and creativity. This imagery resonates with the Jupiter energy of expansion and abundance, while the flowing chakra-like patterns align with the Heart Chakra (Anahata) for compassion and emotional balance. The scene embodies the Water element's nurturing qualities, enhancing intuition and wisdom.
description_zh: 此壁纸展现了一位飘逸的青衣仙子，置身于繁花似锦、绿意盎然的仙境之中。画面以绿色为主调，象征木元素（木），寓意生机与和谐。其流动的气韵与心轮（Anahata）相呼应，带来慈悲与情感平衡；同时亦蕴含水元素的滋养特质，助人提升直觉与智慧。

title: Golden Gourd Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background for Abundance
title_zh: 金葫芦壁纸 — 财运风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This elegant golden gourd wallpaper radiates prosperity and wealth energy, symbolizing abundance and good fortune. The rich golden hue aligns with the Metal element (Metal→Earth), resonating with Jupiter's expansive energy and the Crown Chakra's transcendence. It harmonizes with the Qian trigram (乾) and the Metal zodiac signs (Monkey, Rooster), benefiting those seeking financial growth and success. The gourd's shape represents protection and flow of positive energy, making it ideal for those in finance, business, or law careers.
description_zh: 金色葫芦壁纸，象征招财进宝，气场富贵。金黄色属金属（金生土），对应木火相生组合中的金元素，契合金星的财富能量与顶轮的超凡境界。与乾卦及猴、鸡生肖相合，适合金融、商业或法律从业者提升财运。

title: Clover Wallpaper — Luck & Growth Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 四叶草壁纸 — 生机与好运风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This vibrant wallpaper showcases a dense field of lush green four-leaf clovers, symbolizing luck, growth, and prosperity. From an elemental perspective, the vivid green represents the Wood element (木), which aligns with the Heart/Small Intestine meridian (火) and the Zhen trigram (震), embodying new beginnings and creative energy. The repeating pattern of clovers evokes a sense of abundance and harmony, resonating with Jupiter's expansive energy and the Heart chakra's connection to compassion and vitality. This design is ideal for those seeking to attract positive opportunities and foster personal growth in their daily lives.
description_zh: 这张壁纸以茂密的翠绿四叶草为画面主体，象征幸运、生机与繁荣。从五行角度而言，鲜亮的绿色属木（木），对应心小肠经络（火）及震卦（震），蕴含着新开始与创造力的能量。重复的四叶草图案传递出丰盈和谐之感，与木生火的相生关系相符，也呼应了木元素所代表的肝胆经络（木）。此设计适合希望吸引正向机遇、促进个人成长的人群。

title: Mountain Sunset Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 雪山日落壁纸 — 五行风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This breathtaking mountain sunset wallpaper radiates warmth and clarity, embodying the essence of Fire and Earth energies. The golden sunlight symbolizes vitality and illumination, resonating with the Sun's planetary influence and the Solar Plexus chakra's willpower. The majestic peaks represent stability and grounding, aligning with the Earth element and the Gen trigram (艮), which governs stillness and contemplation. This image is ideal for those seeking balance and inspiration, particularly individuals with a BaZi birth chart favoring Fire and Earth elements (喜火土), such as those connected to the Spleen/Stomach meridian and careers in real estate, healthcare, or finance.
description_zh: 此壮丽雪山日落壁纸散发温暖与清晰之气，象征火与土的能量。金色阳光代表活力与光明，对应太阳行星能量及太阳神经丛脉轮的意志力。巍峨山峰体现稳定与根基，契合土元素及艮卦（艮），主静止与内省。此图适合寻求平衡与灵感之人，尤其八字喜火土者（如脾胃经络相关人士或从事房地产、医疗、金融行业者）。

title: Golden Mountain Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 金山壁纸 — 五行风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This stunning wallpaper depicts a majestic golden mountain bathed in radiant sunlight, symbolizing abundance, prosperity, and spiritual elevation. The dominant golden hue aligns with the Fire element, resonating with the Jupiter energy of expansion and the Solar Plexus chakra's willpower. This imagery is particularly auspicious for those whose BaZi chart favors Fire and Earth (喜火土), as it supports the Heart/Small Intestine meridian and the Kun trigram, enhancing warmth, nurturing qualities, and career success in fields like real estate, healthcare, or hospitality. Use this background to attract positive energy, boost confidence, and manifest growth in both personal and professional life.
description_zh: 画面展现一座金光熠熠的巍峨高山，沐浴在耀眼阳光中，象征财富、繁荣与精神升华。金色主调对应火元素，契合木星能量的扩展与太阳神经丛脉轮的意志力。此图对八字喜火土的人尤为吉祥，可助心小肠经络及坤卦，提升温暖、 nurturing特质，并助力房地产、医疗或餐饮等事业成功。作为壁纸使用，能吸引正能量，增强自信，促进个人与事业的全面发展。

title: Green Forest Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 绿森林壁纸 — 五行风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This aerial view of a lush green forest exudes vitality and growth, symbolizing the Wood element in Feng Shui. The vibrant greens resonate with the Heart/Small Intestine meridian (Fire) and Liver/Gallbladder meridian (Wood), promoting creativity, passion, and emotional balance. Ideal for those with a BaZi 喜木火 (Favorable: Wood + Fire) combination, this image supports careers in arts, education, or entrepreneurship. The upward-reaching trees reflect the Zhen (震) trigram, embodying new beginnings and dynamic energy. Use this wallpaper to inspire personal growth and foster a harmonious environment.
description_zh: 这张俯瞰视角的茂密绿森林图，充满生机与活力，象征着五行中的木元素。鲜亮的绿色与心小肠经（火）及肝胆经（木）相呼应，有助于激发创造力、热情并平衡情绪。适合八字喜木火组合的人群，此图对从事艺术、教育或创业等职业者尤为有益。向上生长的树木体现了震卦（Zhen），蕴含着新开始与动态能量。使用此壁纸可激发个人成长，营造和谐氛围。

title: Fire Flames Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 火焰壁纸 — 火旺风水手机背景
category_zh: 能量壁纸/占星壁纸/自然壁纸
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This captivating wallpaper showcases vibrant fire flames dancing atop charred logs, radiating warmth and illumination. The dominant Fire energy aligns with the Solar Plexus chakra (Manipura), enhancing personal willpower, confidence, and inner strength. In BaZi terms, this image resonates with 喜火土 (Favorable: Fire + Earth) combinations, supporting those whose destiny involves leadership, creativity, or nurturing roles. The Heart/Small Intestine meridian (Fire) is activated, promoting clarity of thought and emotional balance. Ideal for individuals seeking to boost their vitality, drive ambition, or enhance communication skills.
description_zh: 此壁纸呈现熊熊燃烧的火焰跃动于焦黑木柴之上，散发温暖与光芒。主火元素对应太阳轮（Manipura），可增强个人意志力、自信与内在力量。从八字来看，此图契合喜火土组合，适合命理中带有领导、创意或 nurturing 能力的人群。心小肠经（火）被激活，有助于思维清晰与情绪平衡。适合希望提升活力、激发雄心或改善沟通能力者使用。

title: Matterhorn Mountain Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 马特洪峰壁纸 — 五行风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This stunning wallpaper captures the majestic Matterhorn mountain bathed in golden sunlight, with a winding river reflecting its radiant glow. The scene embodies the harmonious energy of Earth and Water elements, creating a serene and grounding atmosphere. The flowing river symbolizes adaptability and emotional depth, while the towering peak represents stability and aspiration. This image resonates with individuals whose BaZi chart favors Earth and Water elements (喜土水), particularly those associated with the Kan (坎) trigram and Kidney/Bladder meridian. It is ideal for people seeking balance, wisdom, and inner peace, especially those in careers related to research, strategy, or healing professions.
description_zh: 这张壁纸展现了马特洪峰在金色阳光下的壮丽景象，蜿蜒的河流映衬着其耀眼光辉。画面融合了五行中的土与水元素，营造出宁静而稳重的能量场。流动的河流象征灵活与情感深度，高耸的山峰则代表稳定与志向。此图适合八字喜土水的人群，尤其是与坎卦（Kan）及肾膀胱经相关者。它特别适合追求平衡、智慧与内心安宁的人，尤其对从事研究、策略或疗愈类职业者有益。

title: Golden Mountain Feng Shui Wallpaper — Harmonize Your Energy
title_zh: 金峰五行壁纸 — 调和能量风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This stunning golden mountain landscape exudes warmth and stability, embodying the Earth element's nurturing energy. The rich golden hues resonate with Jupiter's expansive abundance and Saturn's disciplined structure, while also activating the Sacral Chakra (Water) for creativity and emotional balance. This image is ideal for those whose BaZi chart favors Fire and Earth (喜火土), as it supports the Heart/Small Intestine and Spleen/Stomach meridians, promoting a sense of grounding and prosperity. It benefits individuals in careers such as real estate, healthcare, or food industries, offering a calming yet energizing backdrop for daily life.
description_zh: 金色山峰壁纸，尽显大地之稳与暖阳之光。画面以金黄为主调，契合土生火的五行相生原理，助益心火与脾土经络，带来安定与富足之气。适合八字喜火土之人，尤其对从事房地产、医疗或餐饮行业者尤为有益，可作为提升事业运与生活品质的风水佳品。

title: Golden Waterfall Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 金瀑紫山壁纸 — 五行风水手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This stunning wallpaper depicts a majestic golden waterfall cascading down a luminous purple mountain, surrounded by ethereal clouds and sparkling light. The dominant energy is Water (Kan), symbolizing wisdom, intuition, and emotional depth, resonating with the Third Eye Chakra and the Mercury planet. This imagery enhances clarity of thought and spiritual insight, making it ideal for those seeking mental balance and inner peace.
description_zh: 画面展现一道金色瀑布自紫山倾泻而下，云雾缭绕，金光闪烁。主元素为水（坎），对应智慧、直觉与情感深度，契合第三眼脉轮及水星能量。此图有助于提升思维清晰度与灵性洞察力，适合追求心灵平衡与内在宁静的人群。

title: Mountain Landscape Wallpaper — Feng Shui Harmony for Growth
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This stunning mountain landscape wallpaper embodies the harmonious energy of Wood and Water, creating a serene and inspiring atmosphere. The lush green mountains represent Wood (木), symbolizing growth, vitality, and creativity, while the misty valleys and sparkling stars evoke the fluidity and wisdom of Water (水). This combination aligns with the BaZi favorable elements 喜水木, supporting the Liver/Gallbladder meridian (Wood) and Kidney/Bladder meridian (Water). The trigram Xun (巽) in the southeast further enhances flexibility and personal development. Ideal for those seeking balance, this image promotes career paths in writing, design, healing, or any field requiring innovation and adaptability.
title_zh: 山水画壁纸 — 五行木水相生风水手机背景
description_zh: 此山水画壁纸展现了木水相生的和谐能量，营造宁静而富有灵感的氛围。翠绿山峦象征木（木），代表成长、活力与创造力；云雾缭绕的山谷与闪烁星光则呼应水（水）的灵动与智慧。此组合契合八字喜用神喜水木，支持肝胆经络（木）与肾膀胱经络（水）。东南巽卦进一步增强灵活性与个人发展。适合寻求平衡者，此图有助于写作、设计、疗愈等需要创新与适应能力的职业。

title: Bamboo Forest Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This serene bamboo forest wallpaper radiates the energy of Wood (木), symbolizing growth, flexibility, and renewal. The lush greenery and sunlight streaming through the trees evoke a sense of harmony and vitality, aligning with the Wood element's influence on the Liver and Gallbladder meridians. This image is particularly beneficial for those whose BaZi chart favors Wood and Fire (喜木火), as it supports creativity, passion, and new beginnings. Ideal for individuals in careers such as arts, education, or environmental fields, this wallpaper promotes a balanced and thriving energy flow.
title_zh: 竹林壁纸 — 五行风水手机背景
description_zh: 此竹林壁纸散发木（木）元素的能量，象征成长、柔韧与更新。茂密的绿意与阳光穿透树叶，营造和谐与活力之感，契合木元素对肝胆经络的影响。对于八字喜木火之人，此图尤为有益，可助创意、热情与新开始。适合艺术、教育或环保等领域的从业者，有助于平衡与旺盛的能量流动。

title: Mystical Tree Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This enchanting wallpaper features a towering tree bathed in golden sunlight, symbolizing growth, vitality, and connection to nature. The radiant light and sparkling particles evoke a sense of magic and renewal, aligning with the Wood element's energy of expansion and creativity. This imagery resonates with the BaZi favorable combination of Water generating Wood (水生木), supporting the Liver/Gallbladder meridian and promoting wisdom, personal growth, and career opportunities in fields like writing, design, or healing. The upward-reaching branches mirror the Trigram Zhen (震), representing new beginnings and dynamic energy. Ideal for those seeking inspiration, balance, and a deeper connection to life's natural rhythms.
title_zh: 神秘大树壁纸 — 五行风水手机背景
description_zh: 此壁纸展现一棵沐浴在金色阳光中的参天大树，象征着成长、活力与自然的联结。耀眼的光芒与闪烁的粒子营造出梦幻般的氛围，契合木元素生生不息的能量特质。画面呈现水生木（水生木）的五行喜用组合，滋养肝胆经络，助于智慧增长、个人发展及创意类职业如写作、设计或疗愈领域的发展。向上伸展的枝干对应震卦（Zhen），寓意新生与活力。适合追求灵感、平衡与自然生命力的人群。

title: Lotus Gourd Wallpaper — Feng Shui Phone Background
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This elegant wallpaper features a beautifully ornate gourd adorned with vibrant gemstones, set against a serene lotus backdrop. The dominant blue and green hues evoke the Water element (Kan 坎), symbolizing wisdom, intuition, and emotional depth. The gourd itself represents abundance, longevity, and protection, while the lotus signifies purity and spiritual awakening. This imagery resonates with the 喜水木 (Favorable: Water + Wood) combination, supporting the Kidney/Bladder meridian (Water) and Liver/Gallbladder meridian (Wood). Individuals with this elemental balance benefit from enhanced creativity, growth, and inner peace. Perfect for those in writing, design, or healing professions seeking to harmonize their energy and attract prosperity.
title_zh: 葫芦莲花壁纸 — 五行风水手机背景
description_zh: 此壁纸以华丽的葫芦为主体，镶嵌蓝绿宝石，背景为莲花，整体色调以蓝色和绿色为主，象征水元素（坎卦）。葫芦寓意福禄寿，莲花代表清净与灵性。此图契合“喜水木”组合，滋养肾膀胱经络（水）与肝胆经络（木），适合追求智慧、成长与内心平和的人群，尤其对从事写作、设计或疗愈行业的朋友有助力。

title: Warm Golden Phone Wallpaper - Wealth Feng Shui Background
title_zh: 暖金旺财手机壁纸 — 风水招财背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description:
This warm golden phone wallpaper channels the Metal and Earth elements, symbolizing wealth, abundance, and financial prosperity in Chinese metaphysics. The golden tones mimic the energy of autumn harvest — a season traditionally associated with gathering rewards and material success.

**Best for people who need Metal (金) and Earth (土) energy** — if your BaZi chart shows weak Metal or Earth, or if your favorable element (用神) is Metal, this wallpaper amplifies those energies. It's especially powerful for entrepreneurs, investors, and anyone focused on wealth-building goals. The golden hue activates the Qian (乾) trigram energy, associated with leadership and financial authority.

**Usage tips:** Use during business hours or when making financial decisions for maximum effect. The warm tones pair beautifully with dark mode interfaces. For best results, set as your lock screen so you see it every time you unlock your phone — a visual reminder of your prosperity intention.
description_zh:
這張暖金色手機壁紙匯聚金行與土行能量，象徵財富、豐盛與物質繁榮。金黃色調呼應秋收能量——傳統上與收穫獎賞和物質成功密切相關。

**最適合需要金行（金）與土行（土）能量的人** —— 若你的八字中金或土偏弱，或你的喜用神是金，這張壁紙能放大這些能量。對創業者、投資者和專注於財富累積目標的人特別有效。金黃色調啟動乾卦能量，與領導力和財富權威相關。

**使用建議：** 在商務時段或做財務決策時使用效果最佳。暖色調與深色模式介面完美搭配。為達最佳效果，設為鎖屏畫面，每次解鎖手機都能看見——這是你財富意圖的視覺提醒。

title: Autumn Gold Wallpaper - Prosperity Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 秋香金壁纸 — 风水旺运手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description:
This autumn gold Feng Shui wallpaper captures the essence of seasonal abundance and harvest energy. Rich golden and amber tones evoke the Wood-to-Metal transition of autumn, representing the transformation of growth into tangible results and material rewards.

**Best for people who need Metal (金) energy with Wood (木) support** — if your BaZi favorable element is Metal but you also benefit from Wood's creative energy, this wallpaper bridges both elements perfectly. It's ideal for creative professionals, artists, and anyone who monetizes their creative skills. The autumn theme activates the Dui (兑) trigram, associated with communication, networking, and social wealth.

**Usage tips:** This wallpaper works especially well for people launching new projects or seeking career advancement. The warm golden light creates an inviting, optimistic atmosphere that attracts opportunities. Display on both lock screen and home screen during your project's active phase for sustained motivational energy.
description_zh:
這張秋香金風水壁紙捕捉季節豐盛與收穫能量的精髓。豐富的金黃和琥珀色調喚起秋日木生金的轉化，象徵成長轉化為具體成果與物質回報。

**最適合需要金行（金）能量並輔以木行（木）支持的人** —— 若你的八字喜用神是金，但同時也受益於木的創造能量，這張壁紙完美銜接兩種元素。特別適合創意專業人士、藝術家，以及將創意技能變現的人。秋日主題啟動兌卦能量，與溝通、人脈和社交財富有關。

**使用建議：** 這張壁紙特別適合啟動新專案或尋求職涯晉升的人。溫暖的金光營造出吸引人、樂觀的氛圍，吸引機會到來。在專案活躍期間，同時設為鎖屏和主畫面，以獲得持續的激勵能量。
